protocol.rule: Let L0=mean(y^2), Lsure=threefold validation MSE of fold-trained SURE average, Vhat=max(L0-sigma^2,0). Use full-data SURE weights if L0-Lsure>0.25 Vhat; otherwise uniform weights. Known sigma. No signal-type-dependent decisions. Threshold and fallback selected from24rules on oldseed20261016, now frozen before new outcomes.
protocol.primary: 12 fixed cells at n96, equally weighted. Success requires at least8/12 cell mean gains over CV3>1e-10 AND one-sided95% paired-t lower bound of overall mean gain>0.001 MSE.32 independent banks; average12cells withinbank;df31. Empirical majority plus global mean improvement, not proof that a majority of true cell risks are lower.
protocol.cell_inference: Additionally show12 simultaneous one-sided Bonferroni t lowerbounds, alpha0.05/12. More than6 positive lowerbounds needed for a stronger majority-cell claim under approximate t assumptions. Separate family from overall primary.
protocol.baselines: Same threefold OOF convex stacking and selection transferred to same full-data path; also fixedridgeCVlambda1, unpenalizedSURE average and selection, uniform, last. Equal labels, not equal compute or information: SURE knows sigma. Other comparisons descriptive, no new unadjusted significance claims.
protocol.design: Restricted n96 domain selected after examining seed20261017, where11/12 n96 cells had positive mean gains but full24cell study failed. All3 original functions, both sigmas and horizons retained. Centered tanh width32; W0=2N(0,.7), b0=N(0,.1), a0=Uniform[-.5,.5], lr.25, firstlayer multiplier4. X Uniform[-1,1]^2. Other settings unchanged. No claim for n>=96 generally. Previously failed n48 cells remain reported in first study.
protocol.solver: Exact response Jacobian, QP FWgap<1e-7,max100000; no dropped failures
protocol.status: Second-stage independent confirmation seed20261018 of an explicitly exploratory domain restriction. No changes to rho0.25 or method. Local freeze, not external preregistration. All new12cells retained regardless of outcome.
